0022600215.text: The Orlando Magic (2-7, four straight losses) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-8, two straight losses) with Orlando 12th in the East and Sacramento 15th in the West, both as of today. Orlando is without Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), and Desmond Bane is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and the teams have not met yet this season after the Magic won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 121-117 in Orlando on March 26, 2026.
